visualCharacteristics.purpose: Stacked expandable items holding contact details (phone numbers, opening hours, links) by audience
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-width items with a dark 24px label, a 16px chevron before the label (down when closed, up when open) and a thin grey rule under each item. No outer border or panel background. The first item is open on load; the label turns blue on hover.

contentPattern.structure: One row per item: label | panel content (H3s, paragraphs, phone/email links, lists) | optional "open"
contentPattern.description: Each row becomes a native details/summary item. The label cell is plain text. The panel cell keeps all its rich content. A third cell reading "open" makes that item start open; with none, the first item starts open. The closed option starts every item closed.
contentPattern.blockContent: U.S. patients | Rochester / Phoenix/Scottsdale / Jacksonville / Mayo Clinic Health System phone numbers and hours; International patients | email, phone, U.S. locations list, Representative Offices link
table: Body: H3s, paragraphs with tel: links, link paragraph
Body: paragraphs, H3, bulleted list, links

usage: A short set of expandable items in a content section, such as "Still want to schedule by phone?" on the appointments page.
reuseGuidance: Use for two or more expandable items with plain text labels and rich panels, separated by rules. For a single show/hide text toggle (references, transcript) use accordion-toggle.
